**Finding: Compliant** — no redline proposed.

Section 18 of the agreement satisfies the INSURANCE rule at the **preferred** position, not merely the fallback:

| Playbook (preferred) | § 18.1 |
|---|---|
| CGL USD 1M/occurrence, 2M aggregate | ✔ USD 1,000,000 / 2,000,000 |
| Professional (E&O) USD 2M | ✔ USD 2,000,000 |
| Cyber/privacy USD 5M | ✔ USD 5,000,000 |
| Workers' comp as required by law | ✔ (plus employer's liability USD 1M) |
| Certificates on request | ✔ § 18.2 |

The obligation runs against Vendor (Silverline Systems) for the term plus one year, and § 18.2 layers on additional customer-favourable protections — reputable insurers, primary coverage, advance notice of cancellation or material reduction, and an express statement that insurance does not cap Vendor's liabilities. Nothing here binds Redwood, so there is no reason to flag it.
